text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P0 Pager — spike in 5xx and queue time for eu-west-hosted inference. Indicators: rapid increase in requests routed to economy tier replicas, queue latency > 2s, customer error reports increasing. Alerting on-call.
sara_oncall: Ack. I'm on it. Pulling up tracing + routing dashboard now. /poll
ben_ops: seeing similar on traffic dashboard — economy lane weight for eu-west jumped ~3x at ~3129998600. No config deploys in the last hour according to audit log.
maria_sre: Possible smart-routing decision loop? Past incidents we've seen cost-tier gating mis-evaluate latency when regional capacity transiently drops.
lee_runtime: Getting KV-cache pressure logs from eu-west-2 pods, OOMs on several economy workers ~3129998702. Looks like batching grew unexpectedly. Sharing pod logs:
```
W runtime: batch_size=64 -> 256 for model x-small
E memory: KV cache eviction thrashing
```
anya_support: Two enterprise customers (acme-corp, medsys) reported timeouts. Support tagging CGs and setting priority. Carlos — product impact?
carlos_prod: Acme reports degraded latency for chat endpoints (SLO breach on 99th). Medsys is on Dedicated; looks unaffected, but they hit hosted endpoints via fallback. We need to avoid more cross-tier fallbacks.
ben_ops: Suggest temporary mitigation: 1) reduce economy tier weight in eu-west from 0.3 -> 0.05, 2) throttle incoming per-customer QPS soft limit for non-enterprise, 3) disable automatic fallback to economy for specific route. I can apply steps 1+2 quickly.
sara_oncall: Agreed. Apply 1 and 3 now. Ben, coordinate throttles. I’ll notify customers.
ben_ops: Applying route weight change: `POST /orchestrator/v1/policy/rebalance { region: "eu-west", tier_weights: { economy: 0.05, standard: 0.7, premium: 0.25 } }` -> 200 OK
k8s-deploy-bot: configmap-update: smart-routing-policy-eu-west -> revision 8423 by ben_ops
ben_ops: Throttling non-enterprise QPS: `rls set --region eu-west --selector "!ent_org" --qps 10 --burst 20` -> rules applied
maria_sre: Observability: queue latency now trending down, 95th latency falling from 1.9s to 600ms within 30s of change. 5xx rate dropping. Good signal.
lee_runtime: Patching runtime knob to cap batch growth to 128 to avoid KV thrash: pushing hotpatch to eu-west (non-disruptive): `sh hotpatch.sh --cap-batch 128 --region eu-west` -> hotpatch applied
anya_support: Messaging update sent to affected customers: short note about degraded latency mitigated; offered to open support tickets. Marking acme-corp for SRE follow-up.
carlos_prod: We should schedule post-incident follow-up: root cause, why economy weight spiked, whether decision model mis-read capacity. I'll create postmortem stub.
sara_oncall: Handing off to maria_sre for long-term investigation. I'm going to stand down incident pager in 10m if metrics continue improving.
maria_sre: Taking over. Early hypothesis: transient node GC + cache eviction led to increased latency -> smart-routing controller reweighted traffic to economy to save cost -> feedback loop. Collecting controller decisions, model inputs, and node-level metrics.
lee_runtime: I'll instrument extra logging for batch scaling heuristics and add rate-limited fallback for future. Also recommend default cap on batch multiplier.
ben_ops: Reverted throttle for enterprise and set alert to auto-scale standard replicas if queue depth > X. Also rolled back any risky config changes.
sara_oncall: Thanks team. :thumbsup: Closing pager if last checks look green in 10m.
incident-bot: Pager resolved at 3129999300 — severity reduced to P2. Follow-up required: assign RCA and checklist updates.
